title: On Some Properties of LCM-Lattices of Edge Ideals of k-Uniform Hypergraphs
summary: In this article, we investigate the combinatorial and algebraic properties of the lcm-lattice associated with the edge ideal of a hypergraph. Let $\H$ be a hypergraph, $I(\H)$ its corresponding edge ideal in a polynomial ring in $n$ variables, and $\mathrm{Icm}(I(\H))$ the associated lcm-lattice. We establish conditions under which the lcm-lattice of an edge ideal is Boolean, modular, or complemented.
